title: Aperture Desk Job
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.3
notes: Re-verified on engine r2 on 2026-09-10: the Valve logo, the office scene and the Start/Options/Quit menu all render on DXVK at 30.8 fps, GPU bound at 29 ms per frame. The game puts up a 'Controller Required' banner and needs a gamepad to actually play, which is the game's own requirement. It also shows a 'This game has been optimized for play on the Steam Deck' notice on first run that has to be dismissed. DXVK is the verified renderer: office scene renders clean, ~40 fps, ReShade 6.8.0 works on top (re-verified 2026-08-25). On our macOS 14 test machine the other renderers misbehave with current builds: DXMT 0.80 black screen (it targets macOS 15+), D3DMetal severe texture corruption (GPU identity keys and ReShade ruled out by A/B). On macOS 15+ your results may differ.

dxmt.detail: black screen on macOS 14 (DXMT 0.80 targets macOS 15+)

d3dmetal.detail: fast but heavy texture corruption on macOS 14

verified.fps: 30.8 at the main menu, which renders the office scene live, on DXVK at 1728x1117 with 29 ms of GPU per frame (re-measured 2026-09-10 on engine r2, macOS 26.6.2, M1 Pro; the same figure the r1 run recorded, and it rises to 43.9 with msync). 106 in the office scene on DXMT (fork 7421db2, engine r1). Quote the renderer with the number: they are not interchangeable.
